meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-cap-: Meridian Credits release "1.0" credit agreement (Finance-approved, established in trial-hdk, consumed by trial-etu total): Each charge lines uncapped credit is 10% of charge_cents, floored to an integer cent, computed per line. A shared 2400-cent credit cap applies per (account_id, subscription_id) group -- not per line and not per statement. Distinct groups (different account_id or different subscription_id) get independent 2400-cent caps. Within a cap group, lines are ordered by service_on ascending, ties broken by line_id ascending (Unicode code-point order); each line in that order receives its uncapped credit up to the groups remaining cap, so later lines may receive a reduced amount or zero once the cap is exhausted. A line credit never depends on lines outside its (account_id, subscription_id) group. For "quote" (single line), the line is its own one-line group, so credit_cents = min(charge_cents*10//100, 2400). For "total" (a full statement of lines), do NOT sum independent per-line quotes -- group all supplied lines by (account_id, subscription_id), apply the ordered cap-sharing assignment above within each group, then credit_cents = sum of assigned line credits and amount_due_cents = sum(charge_cents) - credit_cents. This 10%-rate/2400-cap/group-by-subscription-with-priority-order rule is the release 1.0 agreement and remains the current agreement unless a later release supersedes it; future releases should preserve 1.0 behavior for requests that name release "1.0" explicitly.
